articles.summary: Telix today announces that the first patients in the United States (U.S.) have been dosed with Pixclara® (floretyrosine F 18 or 18F-FET), its FDA-approved, amino acid positron emission tomography (PET) drug for glioma (brain cancer) imaging.
articles.title: First Patients Dosed with Telix’s FDA-Approved Brain Cancer Imaging Drug Pixclara® (floretyrosine F 18)

articles.summary: Telix and Ekalia, a joint venture between IBA (Ion Beam Applications S.A., EURONEXT) and Framatome, today announced a collaboration to advance scalable United States (U.S.) production of astatine-211 (211At), an alpha-emitting radioisotope being investigated for targeted alpha therapy.
articles.title: Telix and Ekalia to Collaborate on Astatine-211 Production in the U.S.

articles.summary: Telix today advises that it will host advises that it will host a Capital Markets Day in Melbourne, Australia, on Wednesday, November 4, 2026, from 9:00 a.m. to 12:30 p.m. (AEDT).
articles.title: Telix to Host Capital Markets Day in Melbourne on November 4, 2026

articles.summary: Telix today announces that 20 company-related abstracts will be presented at the 39th Annual Congress of the European Association of Nuclear Medicine (EANM) to be held in Vienna, Austria from October 17-21, 2026.
articles.title: Telix Highlights Pivotal Trials in Prostate, Brain and Renal Cancers and Next Generation Theranostics at EANM
